name: kiwiclip
description: Turn a web product -- including screens behind a login -- into a narrated, captioned demo walkthrough video.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your product into a narrated demo walkthrough video.
interface.longDescription: Record a real flow in your product -- including screens behind a login -- and turn it into a narrated, captioned demo walkthrough video with zoom/highlight annotations and ready-to-paste platform copy. Runs locally with your own credentials and API keys; never posts anywhere on its own.
defaultPrompt: Make a demo video of this product.
Record a walkthrough of this app.
Show how this feature works in a video.
